mapper.select: SELECT IFID , IF_NM FROM INTERFACEINFO WHERE DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT RULEID , RULE_NM , RULEALIAS_NM , RULE_DESC , RULERETURN_TYPE , RULESORT_CD , RULEUSAGE_CD , ALLRETURN_YN , USE_YN , RULE_VERNO , ACTIVATE_YN , TO_CHAR(ACTIVATE_DATETIME, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AS ACTIVATE_DATETIME , (SELECT CODE_NM FROM CLOVER_CODE WHERE CODE_TYPE = '604' AND CODE = RULE_STATE) AS RULE_STATE , TO_CHAR(DEPLOY_DATETIME, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AS DEPLOY_DATETIME , (SELECT USER_NM FROM CLOVER_USER WHERE USER_ID = DEPLOY_USERID) AS DEPLOY_USERID , IFID , FIRSTREG_USERID , FIRSTREG_DATETIME , (SELECT USER_NM FROM CLOVER_USER WHERE USER_ID = UPDATE_USERID) AS UPDATE_USERID , ( SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME, 1, 4) || '/' || SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME, 5, 2) || '/' || SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME, 7, 2) || ' ' || SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME, 9, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME, 11, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME, 13, 2) ) AS UPDATE_DATETIME , CASE WHEN RULE_STATE = '3' AND RULE_VERNO < 1 THEN 'N' WHEN RULE_STATE = '3' AND RULE_VERNO - TRUNC(RULE_VERNO) > 0 THEN 'U' WHEN RULE_APPLY_YN = 'Y' AND DEPLOY_WAIT_STATE_APPY_YN = 'N' THEN 'C' WHEN RULE_APPLY_YN = 'N' AND DEPLOY_WAIT_STATE_APPY_YN = 'Y' THEN 'O' ELSE NULL END AS TREE_ICON_TYPE , RULE_APPLY_YN FROM RULE WHERE 1 = 1
AND IFID = #{value}
AND ( RULEID LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR RULE_NM LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
AND RULE_STATE != 'D' ORDER BY RULEID ASC
SELECT RULE_NM , RULEID FROM RULE

SELECT RULE_NM , RULEID , RULEALIAS_NM , RULE_DESC , RULERETURN_TYPE , ( SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME, 1, 4) || '/' || SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME, 5, 2) || '/' || SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME, 7, 2) || ' ' || SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME, 9, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME, 11, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME, 13, 2) ) AS UPDATE_DATETIME , UPDATE_USERID , RULESORT_CD , RULEUSAGE_CD , FIRSTREG_USERID , FIRSTREG_DATETIME , ALLRETURN_YN , USE_YN , IFID , RULE_VERNO , ACTIVATE_YN , TO_CHAR(ACTIVATE_DATETIME, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AS ACTIVATE_DATETIME , RULE_STATE FROM RULE

SELECT A1.RULEID , A1.RETURN_ITEMID , A1.RETURNITEM_NO , A1.UPDATE_USERID , ( SUBSTR(A1.UPDATE_DATETIME, 1, 4) || '/' || SUBSTR(A1.UPDATE_DATETIME, 5, 2) || '/' || SUBSTR(A1.UPDATE_DATETIME, 7, 2) || ' ' || SUBSTR(A1.UPDATE_DATETIME, 9, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(A1.UPDATE_DATETIME, 11, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(A1.UPDATE_DATETIME, 13, 2) ) AS UPDATE_DATETIME , B.ITEMID , B.ITEM_NM , B.ITEMALIAS_NM , B.ITEMEXPLAN_DESC , B.DATATYPE_CD FROM RULERETURNITEM A1 , RULEITEM B WHERE A1.RETURN_ITEMID = B.ITEMID AND A1.RULEID = #{value}

SELECT I.IF_NM , R.RULE_VERNO , R.RULE_STATE , R.RULE_NM , R.RULE_DESC , R.RULESORT_CD , R.RULEUSAGE_CD , R.UPDATE_USERID , ( SUBSTR(R.UPDATE_DATETIME, 1, 4) || '/' || SUBSTR(R.UPDATE_DATETIME, 5, 2) || '/' || SUBSTR(R.UPDATE_DATETIME, 7, 2) || ' ' || SUBSTR(R.UPDATE_DATETIME, 9, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(R.UPDATE_DATETIME, 11, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(R.UPDATE_DATETIME, 13, 2) ) AS UPDATE_DATETIME , R.RULERETURN_TYPE , R.ALLRETURN_YN , R.ACTIVATE_YN FROM RULE R , INTERFACEINFO I WHERE R.IFID = I.IFID AND R.RULEID = #{value}

SELECT I.ITEMID , I.ITEM_NM , I.ITEMALIAS_NM , I.ITEMEXPLAN_DESC , I.DATATYPE_CD , ( SELECT CODE_NM FROM CLOVER_CODE WHERE CODE_TYPE = '102' AND CODE = I.DATATYPE_CD ) AS DATATYPE_NM , I.UPDATE_USERID , ( SUBSTR(I.UPDATE_DATETIME, 1, 4) || '/' || SUBSTR(I.UPDATE_DATETIME, 5, 2) || '/' || SUBSTR(I.UPDATE_DATETIME, 7, 2) || ' ' || SUBSTR(I.UPDATE_DATETIME, 9, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(I.UPDATE_DATETIME, 11, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(I.UPDATE_DATETIME, 13, 2) ) AS UPDATE_DATETIME , I.FIRSTREG_USERID , I.FIRSTREG_DATETIME , I.ITEM_USE_YN , I.DATATYPE_CD FROM RULERETURNITEM R , RULEITEM I WHERE R.RETURN_ITEMID = I.ITEMID AND R.RULEID = #{value}

SELECT RC.RULEID , RCR.RETURN_ITEMID , (SELECT ITEM_NM FROM RULEITEM WHERE ITEMID = RCR.RETURN_ITEMID) AS ITEM_NM , RC.RULECONDITIONNO , RCR.RETURNITEM_EXPR_DESC , (SELECT DATATYPE_CD FROM RULEITEM WHERE ITEMID = RCR.RETURN_ITEMID) AS DATATYPE_CD , RC.CONDITION_INFIX_DESC , RC.CONDITION_POSTFIX_DESC , RC.CONDITION_DESC FROM RULE R , RULECONDITION RC , RULECONDITIONRETURNITEM RCR WHERE RC.RULEID = R.RULEID AND RCR.RULEID = RC.RULEID AND RCR.RULEID = R.RULEID AND RCR.RULECONDITIONNO = RC.RULECONDITIONNO AND RC.RULEID = #{ruleid} ORDER BY RC.RULECONDITIONNO, RCR.RETURN_ITEMID
SELECT RULECONDITIONNO , CONDITION_INFIX_DESC , CONDITION_POSTFIX_DESC FROM RULECONDITION WHERE RULEID = #{value} ORDER BY RULECONDITIONNO
SELECT LPAD(nextval('rule_main_seq')::text, 7, '0')
SELECT LPAD(nextval('rule_sub_seq')::text, 7, '0')
SELECT RULEID FROM RULE WHERE RULE_NM = #{value} AND RULE_APPLY_YN = 'Y'
SELECT RULEID , POSTFIXOBJECTNO , RULECONDITIONNO , DATATYPE_CD , OPERATOR_YN , OBJECT_DATA FROM RULECONDITION_POSTFIXOBJECT WHERE RULEID = #{value}
SELECT RETURN_ITEMID , RULEID , RULECONDITIONNO , POSTFIXOBJECTNO , DATATYPE_CD , OPERATOR_YN , OBJECT_DATA FROM RULECONDITIONRETURN_POSTOBJECT WHERE RULEID = #{value}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RULERETURNITEM A , RULE B WHERE A.RULEID = B.RULEID AND RULE_NM = #{value}
SELECT B.DATATYPE_CD FROM RULERETURNITEM A , RULEITEM B , RULE C WHERE A.RETURN_ITEMID = B.ITEMID AND C.RULEID = A.RULEID AND C.RULE_NM = #{value}
mapper.update: UPDATE RULE SET USE_YN = 'N' , RULE_STATE = 'D' WHERE RULEID = #{ruleid}
mapper.select: SELECT RULEID , RULE_NM , RULEALIAS_NM , RULE_DESC , RULERETURN_TYPE , RULESORT_CD , RULEUSAGE_CD , ALLRETURN_YN , USE_YN , RULE_VERNO , ACTIVATE_YN , ACTIVATE_DATETIME , RULE_STATE , DEPLOY_DATETIME , DEPLOY_USERID , IFID , FIRSTREG_USERID , FIRSTREG_DATETIME , UPDATE_USERID , UPDATE_DATETIME , RULE_APPLY_YN , DEPLOY_WAIT_STATE_APPY_YN FROM RULE WHERE RULEID = #{value}

SELECT RULEID , RULE_NM , RULEALIAS_NM , RULE_DESC , RULERETURN_TYPE , RULESORT_CD , RULEUSAGE_CD , ALLRETURN_YN , USE_YN , RULE_VERNO , ACTIVATE_YN , TO_CHAR(ACTIVATE_DATETIME, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AS ACTIVATE_DATETIME , (SELECT CODE_NM FROM CLOVER_CODE WHERE CODE_TYPE = '604' AND CODE = RULE_STATE) AS RULE_STATE , TO_CHAR(DEPLOY_DATETIME, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AS DEPLOY_DATETIME , (SELECT USER_NM FROM CLOVER_USER WHERE USER_ID = DEPLOY_USERID) AS DEPLOY_USERID , IFID , FIRSTREG_USERID , FIRSTREG_DATETIME , (SELECT USER_NM FROM CLOVER_USER WHERE USER_ID = UPDATE_USERID) AS UPDATE_USERID , ( SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME, 1, 4) || '/' || SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME, 5, 2) || '/' || SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME, 7, 2) || ' ' || SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME, 9, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME, 11, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME, 13, 2) ) AS UPDATE_DATETIME , RULE_APPLY_YN , DEPLOY_WAIT_STATE_APPY_YN FROM RULE WHERE RULEID = #{value}
SELECT R.RULEID , R.RULE_NM , RI.DATATYPE_CD FROM RULERETURNITEM RR , RULE R , RULEITEM RI WHERE RR.RULEID = R.RULEID AND RR.RETURN_ITEMID = RI.ITEMID AND R.USE_YN = 'Y' AND R.IFID = #{value}

SELECT RULEID , RULE_VERNO , (SELECT CODE_NM FROM CLOVER_CODE WHERE CODE_TYPE = '604' AND CODE = RULE_STATE) AS RULE_STATE , CURRENT_RULE_APPLY_YN , DEPLOY_WAIT_STATE_APPLY_YN , (SELECT USER_NM FROM CLOVER_USER WHERE USER_ID = UPDATE_USERID) AS UPDATE_USERID , ( SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME, 1, 4) || '/' || SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME, 5, 2) || '/' || SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME, 7, 2) || ' ' || SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME, 9, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME, 11, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME, 13, 2) ) AS UPDATE_DATETIME FROM RULE_PROGRESS_HISTORY WHERE RULEID = #{ruleid} ORDER BY HISTORY_NO DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE RULE SET RULE_STATE = '4' , DEPLOY_WAIT_STATE_APPY_YN = NULL WHERE RULEID = #{ruleid}
mapper.select:
SELECT A.RULE_APPLY_YN , CASE WHEN A.RULE_VERNO - TRUNC(A.RULE_VERNO) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS RULE_MODIFY_YN , A.DEPLOY_WAIT_STATE_APPY_YN , A.IFID , A.RULEID , A.RULE_VERNO , A.RULE_NM , ( SELECT USER_NM FROM CLOVER_USER WHERE USER_ID = A.UPDATE_USERID ) AS UPDATE_USERID , ( SUBSTR(A.UPDATE_DATETIME, 1, 4) || '/' || SUBSTR(A.UPDATE_DATETIME, 5, 2) || '/' || SUBSTR(A.UPDATE_DATETIME, 7, 2) || ' ' || SUBSTR(A.UPDATE_DATETIME, 9, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(A.UPDATE_DATETIME, 11, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(A.UPDATE_DATETIME, 13, 2) ) AS UPDATE_DATETIME , ( SELECT D.USER_NM FROM RULE_PROGRESS_HISTORY C JOIN CLOVER_USER D ON C.UPDATE_USERID = D.USER_ID WHERE C.RULEID = A.RULEID AND C.RULE_VERNO = A.RULE_VERNO AND C.RULE_STATE = '3' AND C.HISTORY_NO = ( SELECT MAX(HISTORY_NO) FROM RULE_PROGRESS_HISTORY WHERE RULEID = C.RULEID AND RULE_VERNO = C.RULE_VERNO AND RULE_STATE = C.RULE_STATE ) ) AS DEPLOY_WAIT_USERID , ( SELECT SUBSTR(C.UPDATE_DATETIME, 1, 4) || '/' || SUBSTR(C.UPDATE_DATETIME, 5, 2) || '/' || SUBSTR(C.UPDATE_DATETIME, 7, 2) || ' ' || SUBSTR(C.UPDATE_DATETIME, 9, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(C.UPDATE_DATETIME, 11, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(C.UPDATE_DATETIME, 13, 2) FROM RULE_PROGRESS_HISTORY C WHERE C.RULEID = A.RULEID AND C.RULE_VERNO = A.RULE_VERNO AND C.RULE_STATE = '3' AND C.HISTORY_NO = ( SELECT MAX(HISTORY_NO) FROM RULE_PROGRESS_HISTORY WHERE RULEID = C.RULEID AND RULE_VERNO = C.RULE_VERNO AND RULE_STATE = C.RULE_STATE ) ) AS DEPLOY_WAIT_DATETIME , ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ITEMID) FROM ( SELECT F.RULEID , F.RETURN_ITEMID AS ITEMID FROM RULECONDITIONRETURNITEM F
UNION ALL
SELECT F.RULEID , SUBSTR(F.OBJECT_DATA, 2, LENGTH(F.OBJECT_DATA) - 2) AS ITEMID FROM RULECONDITION_POSTFIXOBJECT F WHERE F.DATATYPE_CD = '3'
UNION ALL
SELECT F.RULEID , SUBSTR(F.OBJECT_DATA, 2, LENGTH(F.OBJECT_DATA) - 2) AS ITEMID FROM RULECONDITIONRETURN_POSTOBJECT F WHERE F.DATATYPE_CD = '3' ) D WHERE D.RULEID = A.RULEID ) AS USED_ITEM_CNT , ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT SUB_RULE_ID) FROM ( SELECT F.RULEID , SUBSTR(F.OBJECT_DATA, 3, LENGTH(F.OBJECT_DATA) - 3) AS SUB_RULE_ID FROM RULECONDITION_POSTFIXOBJECT F WHERE F.DATATYPE_CD = '4'
UNION ALL
SELECT F.RULEID , SUBSTR(F.OBJECT_DATA, 2, LENGTH(F.OBJECT_DATA) - 3) AS SUB_RULE_ID FROM RULECONDITIONRETURN_POSTOBJECT F WHERE F.DATATYPE_CD = '4' ) D WHERE D.RULEID = A.RULEID ) AS USED_RULE_CNT , ( SELECT MAX( SUBSTR(D.DEPLOY_DATETIME, 1, 4) || '/' || SUBSTR(D.DEPLOY_DATETIME, 5, 2) || '/' || SUBSTR(D.DEPLOY_DATETIME, 7, 2) || ' ' || SUBSTR(D.DEPLOY_DATETIME, 9, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(D.DEPLOY_DATETIME, 11, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(D.DEPLOY_DATETIME, 13, 2) ) FROM RULE_DEPLOY D WHERE D.RULEID = A.RULEID ) AS RECENT_DEPLOY_DATE FROM RULE A RIGHT OUTER JOIN RULECONDITIONRETURNITEM B ON A.RULEID = B.RULEID WHERE A.RULE_STATE = '3' GROUP BY A.RULE_APPLY_YN , CASE WHEN A.RULE_VERNO - TRUNC(A.RULE_VERNO) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END , A.DEPLOY_WAIT_STATE_APPY_YN , A.IFID , A.RULEID , A.RULE_VERNO , A.RULE_NM , A.UPDATE_USERID , A.UPDATE_DATETIME

SELECT MAX( SUBSTR(DEPLOY_DATETIME, 1, 4) || '/' || SUBSTR(DEPLOY_DATETIME, 5, 2) || '/' || SUBSTR(DEPLOY_DATETIME, 7, 2) || ' ' || SUBSTR(DEPLOY_DATETIME, 9, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(DEPLOY_DATETIME, 11, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(DEPLOY_DATETIME, 13, 2) ) AS DEPLOY_DATETIME FROM RULE_DEPLOY

SELECT ( SUBSTR(A.DEPLOY_DATETIME, 1, 4) || '/' || SUBSTR(A.DEPLOY_DATETIME, 5, 2) || '/' || SUBSTR(A.DEPLOY_DATETIME, 7, 2) || ' ' || SUBSTR(A.DEPLOY_DATETIME, 9, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(A.DEPLOY_DATETIME, 11, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(A.DEPLOY_DATETIME, 13, 2) ) AS DEPLOY_DATETIME , A.BEFORE_DEPLOY_APPLY_YN , A.AFTER_DEPLOY_APPLY_YN , A.RULE_UPDATE_YN , B.IFID , B.RULEID , B.RULE_NM , U.USER_NM AS DEPLOY_USERID , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RULE_LOG WHERE RULE_ID = A.RULEID AND RULE_VERNO = A.RULE_VERNO AND TO_DATE(SUBSTR(LOG_START_TIME, 1, 8), 'YYYYMMDD') >= CURRENT_DATE - 3 ) AS RULE_CALL_D3 , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RULE_LOG WHERE RULE_ID = A.RULEID AND RULE_VERNO = A.RULE_VERNO AND INSPECTION_YN = 'Y' AND TO_DATE(SUBSTR(LOG_START_TIME, 1, 8), 'YYYYMMDD') >= CURRENT_DATE - 3 ) AS RULE_CHECK_D3 , ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ITEMID) FROM ( SELECT F.RULEID , F.RETURN_ITEMID AS ITEMID , F.RULE_VERNO FROM RULECONDITIONRETURNITEM_HIST F
UNION ALL
SELECT F.RULEID , SUBSTR(F.OBJECT_DATA, 2, LENGTH(F.OBJECT_DATA) - 2) AS ITEMID , F.RULE_VERNO FROM RULECONDITION_POSTFIXOBJECT_HI F WHERE F.DATATYPE_CD = '3'
UNION ALL
SELECT F.RULEID , SUBSTR(F.OBJECT_DATA, 2, LENGTH(F.OBJECT_DATA) - 2) AS ITEMID , F.RULE_VERNO FROM RULECONDITIONRETURN_POSTOB_HI F WHERE F.DATATYPE_CD = '3' ) D WHERE D.RULEID = A.RULEID AND D.RULE_VERNO = A.RULE_VERNO ) AS USED_ITEM_CNT , ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT SUB_RULE_ID) FROM ( SELECT F.RULEID , SUBSTR(F.OBJECT_DATA, 3, LENGTH(F.OBJECT_DATA) - 3) AS SUB_RULE_ID , F.RULE_VERNO FROM RULECONDITION_POSTFIXOBJECT_HI F WHERE F.DATATYPE_CD = '4'
UNION ALL
SELECT F.RULEID , SUBSTR(F.OBJECT_DATA, 2, LENGTH(F.OBJECT_DATA) - 3) AS SUB_RULE_ID , F.RULE_VERNO FROM RULECONDITIONRETURN_POSTOB_HI F WHERE F.DATATYPE_CD = '4' ) D WHERE D.RULEID = A.RULEID AND D.RULE_VERNO = A.RULE_VERNO ) AS USED_RULE_CNT , A.RULE_VERNO FROM RULE_DEPLOY A INNER JOIN RULE B ON A.RULEID = B.RULEID INNER JOIN INTERFACEINFO INT ON B.IFID = INT.IFID INNER JOIN CLOVER_USER U ON A.REG_USERID = U.USER_ID
ORDER BY A.DEPLOY_DATETIME DESC
